description:
Returns the player's server-owned values (Validated Actions): balance, today's earnings and daily cap per value key, such as currency or loot counters.
Use when: the game shows the wallet or checks whether a spend is possible before starting a run.
Not for: changing balances: nothing writes a balance directly, only accepted runs through horizon_submit_validated with earned. Also not for the save game (use horizon_load_cloud_data).
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: None (read only).
Returns: {userId, day, values: [{key, balance, earnedToday, dailyCap}]}: every value key defined in the API key's rules, sorted by key (balance 0 when never earned); values is empty when the rules define no values. day is the current UTC day, earnedToday the positive credit on that day (0 after midnight UTC), dailyCap null without a daily cap; the other value rules stay hidden. Games may mirror the values into cloud save for offline display but must never send them back.
Errors: The error result names the stable code: 401 SESSION_REQUIRED (sign in again), 403 SESSION_FORBIDDEN (pass the userId that signed in), 404 PLAYER_NOT_FOUND, 429 without code (account request limit, wait). Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

sessionToken.description: accessToken from horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous for this userId; sent as a Bearer session

userId.description: Player user ID (UUID) from horizon_signup_* or horizon_signin_*

name: horizon_get_state

anyOf.description: Every value key of the rules, sorted by key
Positive credit on the current UTC day
